Extreme close ground-level view of one anatomically plausible bare adult foot gently pressing into moist fine lakeshore mud and lifting away, leaving a clear five-toed impression; locked low camera, soft dawn light, no exposed body beyond the ankle. Silent output: no audio track, no speech, no dialogue, no music, no ambience and no sound effects. No generated text, captions, publication pages, numbers, coordinates, flags, logos or watermark. No fantasy ruins, holograms, dinosaurs, tsunami, implausible underwater people or claimed spectacular discovery. All reconstructions and laboratory scenes are illustrative, never photographs of a named discovery. For ancient Lake Otero, use an ice-free southern New Mexico basin, plausible wetlands and practical natural clothing; no Arctic village, igloo, dense tropical jungle, modern tools or identity assigned to anonymous people.
